transport: RS-485 over RJ45, Volthium «BMS-TI» pinout: pin 7 = RS485 H, pin 8 = RS485 L, pin 3 unused/open. Baud, framing and addressing are not published. Group-31 packs have one RJ45; 4D/8D packs have two, both RS-485 and interchangeable.
sharedMapEvidence: Deliberately null — this is a dialect: unknown bucket, not a claim that these five share a map. What IS documented across them is a pinout and a BMS silicon vendor: the Smart Bridge manual states 'All Volthium batteries in ABS format, equipped with a communication port, are compatible with the Smart Bridge' and prints one 'RJ45-Volthium «BMS-TI» RS485 pinout' labelled 'Compatible: BMS-TI (ABS)' fo
gotchas: This entry exists to stop these five models being folded into volthium-abs-ej-ble on the strength of 'same vendor, same ABS case'. Nothing shows their frames match. What would settle it, cheaply: put a Volthium Bluetooth Dongle or Smart Bridge on one and read the BLE advertised name. If it matches 'V-12V???Ah-*', aiobm
The 24 V pack (25.6-100-G4DY-CH2OSS) is the least likely to join: aiobmsble's Volthium pattern is 12 V only.

The family is provisional. RS-485 is the documented transport — vendor-doc, from the pinout above — but nothing establishes the framing is Modbus. Placing this in modbus-rs485.md asserts half a fact; say so in the file rather than letting the filename imply a map exists.

Volthium's own manuals contradict the 'BMS-TI (ABS)' label at one point: the 4D-8D and 12V-150Ah manuals both say 'Note that the 51.2V 100AH battery is equipped with a Microchip Technology BMS', so at least one ABS pack is not TI. The 12 V and 24 V packs on this list are stated to be TI.

Each battery gets its own RS-485 pair, not a shared bus. The Smart Bridge octopus adapter maps four separate RS-485 pairs (1-2, 3-4, 5-6, 7-8) from one RJ45 onto four battery RJ45s, each landing on that battery's pins 7-8. So the packs are not multi-drop and are not addressed; a bank of four is four point-to-point link
unmappedReports: Nothing can be listed. No source states what these packs report over RS-485, so any list would be invented. If the E&J frame map turns out to apply, the gaps are the ones recorded under volthium-abs-ej-ble.
